MODULE.name: DocumentPicker
MODULE.HELP_OVERVIEW: API to select document on the device using a document manager

PROPERTIES.DESC: list of properties supported by instance of object

METHOD.name: pickDocument
METHOD.DESC: Trigger opening of a document manager for file selection

PARAM.name: supportedExtensionList
PARAM.DESC: Comma separated list of extensions to be allowed in the document manager

PARAM.name: status
PARAM.DESC: Whether or not the document was successfully captured. The returned string will be one of 'ok', 'error' or 'cancel'

PARAM.name: filePath
PARAM.DESC: Whether or not the document was successfully captured. The returned string will be one of 'ok', 'error' or 'cancel'

PARAM.name: pdfPath
PARAM.DESC: Comma separated list of extensions to be allowed in the document manager

PARAM.name: status
PARAM.DESC: Whether or not the document was successfully captured. The returned string will be one of 'ok', 'error' or 'cancel'
